text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Such delicate fingerwork... 
It was truly marvelous to watch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because the prey doesn't move, it has its 
own 
unique challenges—and its own charms, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Especially the mind games involved 
when their weak point is concealed!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I even let out a gasp without realizing 
it... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Had this been a real hunt, 
the prey surely would have fled by now.
